quote: Copyright By © WeiFang Deman Power Technology Co., LTD.

Founded in 2014, Deman Power Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, development, manufacturing, and maintenance of generator sets. We offer a comprehensive range of diesel generator sets, gas generator sets, and diesel-engine water pumps, covering a power range from 30kW to 3000kW.
Deman Power supplies 30–2000 kW (38–2500 kVA) Yuchai gas generator sets for natural gas, biogas, associated petroleum gas (APG), coal mine methane (CMM), landfill gas, and other gaseous fuels.
